prerequisites.detail: ./gradlew test BUILD SUCCESSFUL — 29 US-03 unit tests (23 batch + 6 notice), 0 failures, 0 skipped

findings.title: @Transactional self-call bypass on processExpireForNotice
findings.details: processExpireForNotice was called via this. from processExpirePhaseForPolicy within the same bean. Spring AOP proxy is bypassed — @Transactional never activates and expiry debit runs without a transaction boundary.

findings.title: TOCTOU race: idempotency check before row lock
findings.details: existsByRewardWalletIdAndReferenceTypeAndReferenceIdAndEntryType was called before lockWallet. Two concurrent sweeps could both pass the check then both write duplicate EXPIRY ledger entries.
findings.recommendation: Move idempotency check to after lockWallet acquisition

findings.title: In-memory cross-policy filter in expire phase
findings.details: processExpirePhaseForPolicy loaded ALL NOTIFIED notices for the client then filtered by policyId in-memory — O(N) over all policies' notices, not just the current policy.

findings.title: LocalDate.now() without ZoneOffset in validateRequest
findings.details: LocalDate.now() uses system default timezone — server timezone drift could cause a fixed expiry date that is valid in UTC to be rejected as past.

findings.title: SecurityContext loss: auditLogService.logAsync() from @Transactional
findings.details: logAsync() is @Async — runs on a different thread where SecurityContext (ThreadLocal) is null. auditLogService.log() silently returns when clientId cannot be resolved, dropping the audit entry.
findings.recommendation: Switch to synchronous auditLogService.log() which resolves SecurityContext on the caller thread

findings.title: Dead variable: UUID ledgerEntryId assigned but never used
findings.details: The local variable ledgerEntryId was assigned savedEntry.getId() but then never referenced.
findings.recommendation: Remove dead variable or add to event metadata for traceability

findings.title: Dead parameter in resolveRecipientsForWalletType
findings.details: Method parameter notice was never used inside the method body.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused parameter; rename to resolveRecipients()

findings.title: Misleading log using pending.get(0).getCurrencyId()
findings.details: Log statement only showed first notice's currency — misleading for multi-currency scenarios.
findings.recommendation: Remove currency from the log or aggregate correctly

findings.title: Unused WalletType import
findings.details: WalletType was imported but not referenced in BalanceExpiryNoticeService.
